Meaning (EN): To start using a plan or method; to take a child legally.
Collocations: adopt a strategy | adopt a policy | adopt a child
Examples: The school adopted a new teaching method. | Many firms now adopt flexible working hours.
Common mistakes: ❌ adopt vs adapt → ✅ adopt = يعتمد/يتبنى — adapt = يتكيف/يعدل.

Meaning (EN): Truthful and straightforward even when it is uncomfortable.
Collocations: a candid answer | a candid discussion | be candid about
Examples: She gave a candid account of the failures. | He was candid about the risks.
Common mistakes: ❌ candid to say → ✅ candid in saying (بدون to).

Meaning (EN): To become gradually smaller or weaker.
Collocations: dwindle away | dwindle rapidly | numbers dwindle
Examples: Supplies dwindled after the drought. | Their savings slowly dwindled to nothing.

Meaning (EN): Dealing with things in a practical way rather than an ideal one.
Collocations: a pragmatic approach | a pragmatic solution | be pragmatic about
Examples: They took a pragmatic approach to the problem. | A pragmatic solution was cheaper and faster.
Common mistakes: ❌ pragmatic of → ✅ pragmatic about أو pragmatic approach.

Meaning (EN): Able to work successfully or to continue.
Collocations: a viable option | a viable plan | commercially viable
Examples: The committee rejected the proposal as not viable. | Solar power is now a viable alternative.
Common mistakes: ❌ viable to do → ✅ viable option أو viable for (بـ for).
